menu_moment.moment: 막 부친 계란후라이를 밥 위에 올려 노른자를 터뜨리고 한 숟갈 먹는 순간

visible_entities: fresh fried egg with runny yolk
Korean metal spoon when action requires it
dining_grammar: fried egg is already placed on top of rice before yolk-breaking begins
metal spoon may press and scoop the egg-rice
no Japanese-style tableware or chopstick placement is introduced by default
no extra soup, seaweed garnish, side dishes or condiments appear unless explicitly added

slides.state_before: rice bowl full; fried egg intact on top; yolk unbroken and runny
slides.action: proxy eater leans attention toward the bowl; no food contact yet
must_show: egg is visibly on top of rice
person is secondary to the bowl
must_not_show: extra meal entities not declared by meal context

observable_cues: thin browned edge on egg white
appetite.reader_proxy_value: the next action promises a visible texture change

copy_plan.copy: 흰자 끝은 살짝 바삭하고, 노른자는 아직 묽다.

slides.state_before: egg remains on rice; yolk intact
slides.action: metal spoon presses into the yolk while the egg stays on the rice
slides.state_after: yolk pierced; yolk begins coating nearby rice grains
slides.visual_delta_from_previous: person/context recedes; contact point and broken yolk dominate
must_show: egg is still positioned on rice
yolk break begins at the contact point
must_not_show: egg broken before being placed on rice

observable_cues: yellow yolk spreads over a limited patch of white rice
appetite.reader_proxy_value: the transformation creates the bite texture rather than merely advancing time

slides.state_before: yolk has coated part of the rice; one spoonful has been scooped
slides.action: proxy eater brings one yolk-coated spoonful into the mouth
slides.state_after: one bite consumed; bowl quantity becomes partial
slides.camera_relation: side-oblique bite view preserving spoon-to-mouth contact
must_show: spoon and mouth contact is physically plausible
must_not_show: extra fingers or broken arm geometry

observable_cues: small coherent spoonful; rice grains visibly coated rather than submerged
appetite.reader_proxy_value: the reader sees the promised transformed bite actually eaten

copy_plan.copy: 노른자 묻은 밥이 입안에서 금방 부드러워진다.

slides.state_before: one bite consumed; bowl quantity partial
slides.action: no new food action; camera reads the physical residue
slides.state_after: partial bowl remains with yolk streaks and missing bite
slides.visual_delta_from_previous: person disappears; same approved residue-food pixels are reused as the sole focal mass
must_show: yolk streaks remain where mixing/contact occurred
state is clearly later than S01

observable_cues: yellow coating and spoon-scoop gap remain visible
appetite.reader_proxy_value: the ending proves the bite happened without an evaluative punchline

same identity as context pose; integrated hand-spoon-mouth contact because over-atomizing this geometry is unsafe
ceramic bowl, white rice, fried egg already on top, runny yolk intact
same meal after spoon contact begins; yolk broken and coating nearby rice
